campaign_logline: A small pilot gets entangled in a jurisdictional dispute between three local powers over some very expensive scrap metal.
opening_situation: You are broke and running on fumes, facing one Reaver-class hostile that seems awfully interested in your hull plating.
main_mystery: Uncovering which of the major powers has the deepest financial stake—and greatest capacity for blackmail—regarding a specific piece of contested orbital salvage rights.
act_1_outline: Secure enough credits from a low-stakes job to keep breathing and avoid immediate creditors.
Gain initial, suspicious local intel regarding resource allocation discrepancies.
Get drawn into a minor conflict that requires navigating the political niceties of Zenith's core sector.
long_term_reveal: The three powers are not fighting over resources; they are each desperately trying to control access to an off-world debt ledger detailing who owes whom everything.
tone: Gritty, bureaucratic desperation with a side of cheap synth-whiskey.
core_pressure: Maintaining enough liquidity and reputation capital to avoid being swallowed whole by competing corporate interests.

factions.zenith: Zenith is over-regulating salvage rights to extract maximum tariffs, effectively choking off independent enterprise profits.
factions.aurelia: Aurelia has begun hoarding specific rare isotopes needed for basic life support systems, creating artificial scarcity panic.
factions.vanguard: Vanguard is aggressively enforcing outdated territorial claims on neutral jump points, making passage increasingly risky.

kaelen_rule: Kaelen operates publicly as a contract handler, accepting assignments from whoever pays the highest rate while maintaining plausible deniability about her true clientele.
kaelen_angle: She knows the precise point of failure for each major faction's primary revenue stream, making casual threats against them trivial to enact or deflect.
kaelen_hint_plan: She always accepts payment in scrip denominations that are slightly outdated or non-standard issue.
She seems overly concerned with the maintenance logs of your ship, asking specific questions about older drive coils.
When discussing local law, she uses highly technical jargon mixed with deliberately incorrect jurisdictional codes.
She keeps a physical ledger book open during conversations, even when reviewing digital data feeds.
kaelen_hint_style: Over-precise-details regarding procedural minutiae and obsolete regulations.
kaelen_never_reveal: Her true relationship to the original chartering body that established the three current powers' jurisdictions.
faction_reveal_rule: New systems reveal a faction via mandatory local governance postings or intercepted, unencrypted corporate comms logs found at jump points.
humor_rule: Humor derives from bureaucratic absurdity and characters treating deadly threats with extreme professional annoyance.
address_rule: They address the player as 'Pilot' or by their registered callsign, without preamble or false familiarity.
fallback_rule: If a specific data point is missing, assume it relates to an immediate, petty financial failure (e.g., overdue docking fees, minor cargo contamination).
story_horizon_rule: New horizons introduce new jurisdictional bodies that complicate the existing three-way tension by adding overlapping regulations or competing claims on salvage rights.

story_arcs.name: The Scrip Debt Spiral
story_arcs.summary: The player must navigate a series of escalating financial gambles, moving from minor debts to systemic compromises between Zenith, Aurelia, and Vanguard's operational spheres.

rumor_trails.name: The Unclaimed Manifest
rumor_trails.hint_theme: A list of assets or persons that legally belong to no one, but are highly valuable enough for multiple parties to fight over ownership.
clue_templates: A partial manifest listing several high-value components marked 'Pending Jurisdiction Transfer'.
Testimony from a minor dock worker claiming they saw an unaccounted salvage vessel loading cargo at the edge of the recognized zone.
rumor_trails.payoff: Discovery of a neutral, pre-existing arbitration court charter that none of the three major powers currently recognize or control.

regeneration_triggers.description: When the primary story arc concludes, trigger a new rumor trail based on the fallout of the resolved conflict.

expansion_rules: New factions will challenge jurisdiction over key orbital choke points rather than entire systems.
Story arcs will focus on resolving specific types of 'asset ownership' disputes (e.g., intellectual property rights, unique biological samples).
